recommendation: Keep the combined-branch audit commit as-is for core reconciliation. Any further editorial cleanup or generated publication checks for this extension should be handled in the FHIR Extension Pack rather than by adding a duplicate core definition.
issue_request: FHIR-34207 asked for a way to document that a ServiceRequest confirmed a verbal order. The Applied / Persuasive with Modification resolution instead created an externalCommunication extension, 0..* Reference(Communication), on Appointment, CarePlan, CommunicationRequest, DeviceRequest, MedicationRequest, NutritionOrder, RequestOrchestration, ServiceRequest, VisionPrescription, and Task.
initial_application: No matching FHIR-34207 or external-communication source/history was found in the core HL7/fhir checkout. Jira comment evidence points to HL7/fhir-extensions PR #229, where commits 95fbc84 and dcabe6a created StructureDefinition-externalCommunication.xml and set OO ownership before merge commit 1a68fe0.
additional_context: The Jira grouping is Extension-pack / R6-Extension. The current core fhir.ini lists the target resources as active resources, but the extension definition is maintained outside this core checkout. OO minutes from 2026-02-24 record the same motion and vote, and bounded Zulip searches found no conflicting community discussion.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. The current Extension Pack source defines http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/external-communication with the resolved contexts, max cardinality, and Reference(Communication) value, so the correct core reconciliation is an external-repo audit commit.
